# Mean

> [double Weibull][double-weibull-distribution] distribution [expected value][expected-value].

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

The [expected value][expected-value] for a [double Weibull][double-weibull-distribution] random variable is

<!-- <equation class="equation" label="eq:dweibull_expectation" align="center" raw="\mathbb{E}\left[ X \right] = 0" alt="Expected value for a double Weibull distribution."> -->

```math
\mathbb{E}\left[ X \right] = 0
```

<!-- </equation> -->

where `c > 0` is the shape parameter.

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var mean = require( '@stdlib/stats/base/dists/dweibull/mean' );
```

#### mean( c )

Returns the [expected value][expected-value] of a [double Weibull][double-weibull-distribution] distribution with shape parameter `c`.

```javascript
var y = mean( 1.0 );
// returns 0.0

y = mean( 4.0 );
// returns 0.0

y = mean( 8.0 );
// returns 0.0
```

If provided `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

```javascript
var y = mean( NaN );
// returns NaN
```

If provided `c <= 0`, the function returns `NaN`.

```javascript
var y = mean( 0.0 );
// returns NaN

y = mean( -1.0 );
// returns NaN
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- Package usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var uniform = require( '@stdlib/random/array/uniform' );
var logEachMap = require( '@stdlib/console/log-each-map' );
var EPS = require( '@stdlib/constants/float64/eps' );
var mean = require( '@stdlib/stats/base/dists/dweibull/mean' );

var opts = {
    'dtype': 'float64'
};
var c = uniform( 10, EPS, 10.0, opts );

logEachMap( 'c: %lf, E(X;c): %lf', c, mean );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<!-- C usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

### Usage

```c
#include "stdlib/stats/base/dists/dweibull/mean.h"
```

#### stdlib_base_dists_dweibull_mean( c )

Returns the [expected value][expected-value] of a [double Weibull][double-weibull-distribution] distribution with shape parameter `c`.

```c
double out = stdlib_base_dists_dweibull_mean( 4.0 );
// returns 0.0
```

The function accepts the following arguments:

-   **c**: `[in] double` shape parameter.

```c
double stdlib_base_dists_dweibull_mean( const double c );
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- C API usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

### Examples

```c
#include "stdlib/stats/base/dists/dweibull/mean.h"
#include "stdlib/constants/float64/eps.h"
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>

static double random_uniform( const double min, const double max ) {
    double v = (double)rand() / ( (double)RAND_MAX + 1.0 );
    return min + ( v*(max-min) );
}

int main( void ) {
    double c;
    double y;
    int i;

    for ( i = 0; i < 25; i++ ) {
        c = random_uniform( STDLIB_CONSTANT_FLOAT64_EPS, 10.0 );
        y = stdlib_base_dists_dweibull_mean( c );
        printf( "c: %lf, E(X;c): %lf\n", c, y );
    }
}
```

</section>
